canvas-charcoal.$description: Canvas Charcoal — Page background, primary canvas surface

elevated-ink.$description: Elevated Ink — Card surfaces, product window backgrounds, logo tiles — one step deeper than canvas for contrast

slate-surface.$description: Slate Surface — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-void.$description: Deep Void — Nav fills, deepest surface tone, pure black accents

near-black.$description: Near Black — List borders, hairline dividers, subtle structural edges

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary text, icons, borders, high-contrast elements — the dominant interface color

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted body text, secondary headings, subtle borders — readable but recessive

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — Light borders, disabled-state text, very subtle dividers

dim-stone.$description: Dim Stone — Placeholder/disabled surfaces, inactive list backgrounds

signal-yellow.$description: Signal Yellow — Yellow outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

suisse-international.$description: Primary typeface for all UI text, body, navigation, buttons, and most headings

suisse-works-book.$description: Italic display emphasis in hero and section headlines
